sections.title: Player win rates
sections.tldr: GRCX leads at 65.1%, ragnarneves trails at 34.9%, on 43 games. One standard error is about 8 points.

sections.title: Duo win rates
sections.tldr: Best pairing: GRCX + BabyGolem at 76.5% (13-4). Worst: RikiPlancha12 + ragnarneves at 23.5% (4-13). Every duo has few games, so none of this is settled.

sections.title: Champion win rates
sections.tldr: 101 distinct champions in 172 player-games. Best with >= 2 games: Lillia 100.0% (4-0), Sylas 100.0% (4-0), Warwick 100.0% (3-0).

sections.title: Tilt tracker
sections.tldr: After a loss: 45.8% (72 games). After a win: 54.2% (72 games). Losses are followed by more losses, but within sampling noise.

sections.title: Session fatigue
sections.tldr: 7 sessions, longest 10 games. Late-session samples are small and biased. Biggest drop from games 1-3 to 4+: GRCX (71.4% to 59.1%).

sections.title: Time of day
sections.tldr: 28 of 43 games began between 00:00 and 05:59.

sections.title: Game length buckets
sections.tldr: Short: 4 games, mid: 33, long: 6. Best in short games: GRCX (100.0%). Best in long games: GRCX (83.3%).

sections.title: Stomp vs throw
sections.tldr: Average game 16:25; shortest 9:52 (won by GRCX + BabyGolem), longest 25:30 (won by BabyGolem + ragnarneves). Widest loss-vs-win length gap: GRCX (+63 s).

sections.title: Multikills
sections.tldr: GRCX leads with 37 multikills. Group: 107 doubles, 0 triples, 0 quadras, 0 pentas.

sections.title: First blood
sections.tldr: Teams with first blood won 48.8% (21-22); without it 51.2% (22-21). Most first-blood kills: GRCX (17).

sections.title: Combat profile
sections.tldr: Highest kill pace: GRCX (0.43/min). Highest death pace: BabyGolem (0.41/min), lowest: GRCX (0.37/min). Lowest damage per kill (kill-steal index): BabyGolem (4,362).

sections.title: Team share
sections.tldr: GRCX takes the largest damage share (55.1%); ragnarneves is the biggest punching bag (35,338 damage taken per game).

sections.title: Champion pool
sections.tldr: Widest pool: RikiPlancha12 (39 champions in 43 games). Narrowest: ragnarneves (favourite Lillia x3).

sections.title: Liability index
sections.tldr: Highest deaths per minute: Kayn (0.61), then Annie (0.56), Sejuani (0.55). Min 2 games.

sections.title: Records

sections.title: Worst defeats
sections.tldr: Most deaths in a loss: RikiPlancha12 on Zyra, 12 deaths (60.0% of the team's deaths).

sections.title: Clean execution
sections.tldr: 0 deathless wins across 172 player-games.

sections.title: Time dead
